name: Primalist Dreamway: the portal takes group members, and only them, to Seradane, and the teleport takes the Primalist there (#11514)
contract: Report #11514: the Primalist Dreamway portals and teleports do nothing.
Dreamway: Seradane 809938 is a 10 second cast whose TRANS_DOOR effect places gameobject 376299, which had no gameobject_template row, so nothing was placed.
The live object 376299 (AscensionDB client captures, 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-07) is a party-only spellcaster that casts Dreamway: Seradane 804741.
Teleport 804741 is a TELEPORT_UNITS to TARGET_DEST_DB with no spell_target_position row; its destination is the stock game_tele Seradane, 799.721, -3995.68 on map 0.

After the portal is cast, the object must stand in the world, a group member who uses it must arrive at Seradane, and a player outside the group must not; the Primalist's own teleport must arrive there too.
